integrity.computational_evidence: independently enumerated original total domination constraints at 3 <= n <= 20

scientific_limitations: The all-order scalar VC boundary is already implied by a published fixed-weight cycle theorem and is not independently claimed as novel.
Exact classification is for simple cycles and minimum-cardinality total dominating sets only.
Finite checker is corroboration, not infinite or topological certification.
Unindexed equivalent statements may exist under alternative terminology.
title: Four-residue shattering and a homological jump for minimum total domination of cycles
